hero.desc: Smart system for any type of business — bars, restaurants, events, retail, and franchises. Crosses cameras, payment terminals and sales systems in real time.

problem.title: How much have you lost without noticing?
problem.desc: In any operation with people flow and money, deviation rarely happens in a single large transaction. It occurs in small repeated gaps shift after shift — bills that disappear, unrecorded sales, differences that never show up in closing.

fullRoom.title: Full venue, incompatible register
fullRoom.desc: The camera counts 90 clients, the register records consumption for 40. The difference comes out of your profit.

gapMachine.title: Terminal doesn't match the system
gapMachine.desc: R$ 5,140 on the terminal, R$ 4,820 in the system. The R$ 320 difference goes unanswered.

cashManipulated.title: Cash handled without record
cashManipulated.desc: Camera detects bills being counted. No corresponding entry found.

rules.title: Three rules. Zero margin for deviation.
rules.desc: Rules run directly in the PostgreSQL database, without depending on the frontend. Each event triggers detection instantly.

r01.title: Movement Without Register
r01.desc: Cameras cross the actual space occupancy with registered sales. If customer flow doesn't reflect in the register, the alert fires immediately.

r02.title: Financial Gap
r02.desc: Automatic reconciliation between the amount received at the terminal and recorded in the sales system. Any divergence is flagged.

r05.title: Cash Ghost
r05.desc: Dedicated camera detects bill manipulation. If there is no corresponding entry in the system, a high criticality alert is fired.

how.title: Complete setup in less than a day.

step1.title: Install the cameras
step1.desc: Cameras with ISAPI support connect automatically via webhook. Any model can be integrated via Raspberry Pi.

step2.title: Connect your systems
step2.desc: Integrate your sales system via webhook or import CSV reports. No extra development.

step3.title: Receive real-time alerts
step3.desc: The rules engine runs in the database and notifies via Telegram and WhatsApp before the shift closes.

integrations.title: Integrates with what you already use.

cta.title: Start protecting your business today.

form.name: Camera name
form.cameraIdHint: Auto-generated. This will be the channelName in the camera's ISAPI config.

intelbras.1: Access the camera's web panel via its IP in the browser.
intelbras.2: Go to Configuration → Events → People Counting → Webhook.
intelbras.3: In the channelName field (or Channel Name), enter: {{cameraId}}
intelbras.4: Paste the webhook URL and the Bearer token in the authentication field. Save.

dahua.1: Access the camera's web panel via its IP in the browser.
dahua.2: Go to Configuration → Events → People Counting → HTTP Report.
dahua.3: In the server ID or channel name field, enter: {{cameraId}}

generic.1: Access the camera's web panel and find the webhook or HTTP push section.
generic.2: Paste the webhook URL and add the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
generic.3: In the identifier or channel name field, use: {{cameraId}}
